trajectory_summary: The call opens with a genuinely interested, early-stage lead who is upfront that the physical structure for solar isn't built yet. The rep correctly identifies this as a soft DQ but exits the call too quickly, missing two clear enthusiasm signals (net metering, battery bank interest) that surfaced right as he tried to close, and settles for handing out a personal phone number instead of a structured next step.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag unknown; based on transcript this is a soft/informal DQ (no roof/structure yet) but the rep's ad hoc personal-number handoff with no scheduled follow-up leaves it effectively no_appointment, not a proper DQ close or a booked callback.

observed_outcome.quote: I'll shoot you a text message with my personal number.
observed_outcome.reasoning: No structure/roof exists yet, so the rep correctly disqualifies for now, but ends the call with an informal personal-number handoff and no scheduled callback date or time — no next step owned by Ion's process.

bill_anchor_audit.reasoning: No dollar amount or kWh usage was captured on the call, so there was nothing to flip or use.

bill_document_audit.reasoning: The rep did not request the utility bill or ask the customer to send a bill during the call.

interest_reason_audit.reasoning: Customer's stated reason (workshop/barn build, revisiting old numbers with new tech) was acknowledged but never tied back into a follow-up plan or used to anchor the personal-number handoff.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: Enthusiasm signals ignored after premature call-close
primary_coaching_focus.quote: I would be interested in the system that has battery banks.
primary_coaching_focus.why: Two strong buying signals (net metering, battery interest) surfaced right as the rep tried to hang up and were not captured for follow-up — a lost opportunity distinct from the DQ itself.

key_moments.quote: I'd love to build a larger workshop this year
key_moments.stewart_read: Customer's motivation is tied to a planned workshop/barn build — a future structure that will need power and roofing, a natural tie-in for a scheduled follow-up.

key_moments.quote: So we are unable to help you right now without anything built or, like, something to work off of with, like, a roof design or anything.
key_moments.stewart_read: This is a legitimate procedural gate (no structure exists yet to design against), correctly identified, but handled as a hard stop rather than a scheduled future touchpoint.

key_moments.quote: I'll shoot you a text message with my personal number.
key_moments.stewart_read: Personal-number handoff is the flagged anti-pattern — untracked, unscalable, and puts follow-up burden entirely on the customer.

key_moments.quote: I'm in the Rappahannock Electric Cooperative zone
key_moments.stewart_read: Customer asks a specific net-metering policy question the rep doesn't know; rep hedges rather than admitting the gap cleanly or offering to find out.
